address: 2, Lane 512, Dungning Road, East District, Tainan, Taiwan
bio: Fukai means ‘deep’ in Japanese. The room aptly sports a backdrop of rich textures and dark hues and seeks to offer a global experience by way of uniquely local flavours (such as pickled watermelon, salted cabbage or pickled chillies), paired with well-honed European techniques. The 9-course tasting menu changes every quarter to showcase the best seasonal ingredients. The winter menu includes heartwarming soups. For a fee, the main can be upgraded.
